statusDefinitions.evidenced-bounded: Positive bounded generated v7 parser/compiler evidence for a limited source family, not full normative conformance
statusDefinitions.partial: Some concrete PSC0 implementation/evidence, but one or more v7 requirements not established
statusDefinitions.not-qualified: Required v7 source or behavior has no demonstrated full v7-path qualification; implementation may exist elsewhere
statusDefinitions.planned-staged: Design-selected P1 capability, gated by later explicit environment or libraries, not default v7 Standard
statusDefinitions.excluded: Forbidden v7 source/behavior; acceptance is negative refusal, not feature implementation
statusDefinitions.deferred: Explicitly outside v7 baseline or optional future extension, not a missing P0 conformance obligation

costDefinitions.XL: very substantial/refactoring or reuse Lean required
